SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT i.item_id AS itemId, MAX(i.item_name) AS itemName, p.title AS productTitle, (p.id IS NOT NULL) AS platformProduct, p.pricing AS pricing, MAX(i.plan_type) AS planType,
COUNT(DISTINCT i.campaign_id) AS campaignCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.campaign_id) AS campaignId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.campaign_name ORDER BY i.campaign_name SEPARATOR '、') AS campaignName, COUNT(DISTINCT i.stat_date) AS days, ROUND(SUM(i.charge), 2) AS charge, SUM(i.ad_pv) AS adPv, SUM(i.click) AS click, ROUND(SUM(i.click) / NULLIF(SUM(i.ad_pv), 0) * 100, 4) AS ctrPercent, ROUND(SUM(i.charge) / NULLIF(SUM(i.click), 0), 4) AS cpc, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total), 2) AS gmvTotal, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_direct), 2) AS gmvDirect, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_indirect), 2) AS gmvIndirect, SUM(i.order_total) AS orderTotal, ROUND(SUM(i.gmv_total) / NULLIF(SUM(i.charge), 0), 2) AS roi, SUM(i.cart_count) AS cartCount, SUM(i.collect_total) AS collectTotal FROM promo_cost_item_daily i LEFT JOIN platform_product p ON p.code = i.item_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
i.dimension = 'item' AND i.stat_date BETWEEN #{dateFrom} AND #{dateTo}
AND i.plan_type = #{planType}
AND i.campaign_id = #{campaignId}
AND (i.item_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.item_id = #{keyword})
GROUP BY i.item_id, p.id, p.title, p.pricing ) t
WHERE IFNULL(t.charge, 0) > 0 AND IFNULL(t.gmvTotal, 0) = 0
WHERE t.platformProduct = 0
WHERE IFNULL(t.charge, 0) > 0 AND (t.pricing IS NULL OR t.pricing = 0)
ORDER BY t.gmvTotal IS NULL, t.gmvTotal DESC ORDER BY t.roi IS NULL, t.roi DESC ORDER BY t.click IS NULL, t.click DESC ORDER BY t.charge IS NULL, t.charge DESC
